title: Custom Resources are permanently mistyped if preloaded too early
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]
- Reproduced on v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA T500 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7357) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-1135G7 @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.72 GiB memory

### Issue description

If a script is loaded, and it preloads a custom resource whose script has not itself been loaded yet, the resource will be typed as a basic Resource instead of its custom type. Attempting to explicitly cast the preload with the custom type seems to have no effect.

If this occurs, any other scripts which preload the resource will see it only as a basic Resource rather than the correct type, even after the type's script is loaded. Using `load()` with implicit typing will also result in a basic Resource when it otherwise wouldn't (although in the case of `load()` explicit casting will fix the issue).

Attempting to use a variable that has been mistyped in this manner results in an error. In the MRP, the error reads as follows:
`Invalid assignment of property or key 'attribute' with value of type 'Resource' on a base object of type 'RefCounted (Thing)'.`

The end result is that whether or not a preloaded resource works correctly can depend on an otherwise completely unrelated script that preloads the same resource. And since the explicit cast fails silently, there is no trace to point towards that script.

The issues referenced in #109345 sound similar, so the cause may be similar as well. However, in those issues the resource failed to load at all, whereas here it's only typed incorrectly.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Load a script that preloads a custom resource type.
2. Load that type's script.
3. Load another script that preloads the same custom resource.
4. Attempt to use the preloaded variable from (3) in any type-dependent context.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[load-order-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22635188/load-order-mrp.zip)
